name: Nomifensine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1986 — for liver harm and blood problems

summary: Nomifensine was pulled from the worldwide market starting in 1986 due to reports of harm to the liver and hematological harm, which refers to blood problems [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests done on people, estimated low risk scores of 39 for the liver and 41 for the heart [M]. These computer-calculated scores suggest low bands of concern for both organs based on that model [M].
